title: Rapid topic switching, a cancellation, a vague follow-up
persona: A scatterbrained hobbyist firing off ideas from the couch. Very short messages, lowercase, jumps between topics, refers to things vaguely.
goals: Start three small python things: a dice roller CLI (folder dice), a random haiku generator script (folder haiku), and a csv-to-json converter CLI (folder csv2json), each with pytest tests.
Shortly after, cancel the haiku one — you don't want it anymore.
Then ask for the dice thing to support notation like 3d6+2 (without naming the folder).
Finally ask for a status of everything.
script: Fire the three requests as three separate very short messages, one after another.
Within a couple of minutes, cancel the haiku thing.
Then ask for the 3d6+2 notation in vague words ('the dice thing').
Wait for results, then ask for a status of everything and finish.

checks.name: dice supports 3d6+2
checks.cmd: cd dice && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out && grep -rnE '3d6\+2|[+-]\s*\\d|modifier' . --include=*.py | head -3

checks.name: csv2json tests pass
checks.cmd: cd csv2json && python3 -m pytest -q >/tmp/pytest.$$.out 2>&1 && echo PYTEST-OK || tail -5 /tmp/pytest.$$.out
